mistake: 80 Kling credits charged for a job whose ID was lost; ledger carries an unresolved row
root_cause: job ID not persisted immediately after submission
solution: persist returned job ID and charge before any other action; query the task list by CLI to recover or mark unrecoverable
rule_added: W38 'persist immediately'; .claude/hooks/no-retry.py; lint advisory on unreconciled rows

mistake: Two image jobs charged 41 credits each against an expected ~20; 70 vs 30 on identical 5 s videos
cost: two 41-credit image charges and a 70-versus-30 video delta, not reconciled (no total asserted)
root_cause: pricing inferred from documentation, not read from the live schema per job
solution: record model, resolution and option flags per job; compare each charge to the documented rate and flag deltas
rule_added: scope.json requires modelInputSlots and ceiling; ledger notes carry the option set

mistake: Phase A request.json passed 5 images to gemini-3-pro-image, which declares image_1/image_2 only
root_cause: request assembled from a plan rather than from the live who_am_i schema
solution: request-r2 with 2 inputs; every request validated against the declared slot count before submit

mistake: Galileo preview v1 places the resolution reaction (21.5-25.5 s) before the line that motivates it, G-L04 (25.5-33.5 s)
root_cause: reaction cut from eye references without checking the audio timing of the causing line
solution: a reaction never precedes its cause; timeline v2 re-ordered against measured dialogue
rule_added: W41 sync review row; direction doc section 5

mistake: Listening pilots show a different table and seat than the speech clips (F01)
cost: pilot takes not reusable as shared-space evidence
root_cause: pilot shots generated without a locked table geometry and axis packet
solution: over-the-shoulder reference packet with D04 table and D09 axis before any new motion; D17 geometry recorded only after an accepted test shot
rule_added: W35 reference packet gate; chapter checklist row 'Safe motion/axis/reference packet'

mistake: Scene bibles v1 section 3 still carry dialogue superseded by script v2 (F05); continuity matrix has stale-stage lines (F06)
cost: risk of generating against old lines
root_cause: bible revisions appended as proposals without one integrated revision per chapter
solution: one revision per bible citing D07 and D20; matrix v2

mistake: D16 (23-credit Phase A test) recorded as relayed via a bot rather than confirmed by Andre directly
root_cause: approval provenance not checked against the Andre-only gate list
solution: Andre confirms or supersedes directly; decision record updated with grantedBy and quote; relayed grants never pass preflight

mistake: First Parley round delivered research and documents but not the new images; the principal creative delivery was not kept explicit
detected_by: REPEATABLE_WORKFLOW lessons of the first Parley round
cost: one round without the deliverable the film needed
root_cause: assignments did not name the one creative deliverable, what blocked it and who owned the blocker
solution: every dispatch names the deliverable, the blocker that stops it and the owner; successor hook on every delivery

mistake: Coordinator role added with a brief and protocol that told it to write the board and decision store the ownership table reserves to the producer and director
detected_by: repository review after PR 5, then Copilot review of PR 6
cost: one extra PR and a rewritten brief and protocol; no canonical record was wrongly written
root_cause: new role documents were not checked against the ownership table in docs/PARLEY_PROTOCOL.md
solution: brief and protocol rewritten so the coordinator proposes through handoffs (blockers[], proposedDecisions); producer and director apply them
rule_added: agents/registry.json canonicalWriteAuthority false; canonical-guard hook refuses lane writes to those records; check any new role against the ownership table before merging

mistake: Two sessions registered the coordinator role in agents/registry.json at the same time; git merged both cleanly and left a duplicate role ID on main
detected_by: merge of main into the PR branch, checked against the role list
root_cause: textual merges do not catch semantic duplicates; PR 6 was merged before the review-fix commit was pushed
solution: kept the entry already on main, folded the extra safeguard into it, removed the duplicate
rule_added: manage.py validate rejects duplicate role IDs; run validate after every merge of main

mistake: PR merged while its head did not yet contain the latest review-fix commit, so the fixes missed main
detected_by: PR 7 review of main after the merge
root_cause: I replied to review and treated the PR as final without confirming its head matched my last push
solution: opened a follow-up PR with the missed fixes
rule_added: before merging or calling a PR final, confirm its head SHA equals the last commit pushed; pass expectedHeadSha on merge

mistake: Edited files covered by a pending, not yet ingested handoff, so its changedFiles hashes went stale and lint reported hard sha256 mismatches
detected_by: manage.py lint after the tasks/ split
cost: three hashes refreshed by hand in the pending handoff
root_cause: no check of pending handoffs before editing files they list
solution: refreshed the hashes, kept delivered values as sha256AfterDelivered with a refresh note
rule_added: before editing a file, check whether a pending handoff lists it and refresh that handoff in the same change

mistake: Restructure handoff inventory omitted a handoff file the same change had modified
cost: one review round; fixed in a3b001f
root_cause: inventory was written from memory instead of from the diff
solution: added the file with before and after hashes and stated the ingest order
rule_added: build baseFiles and changedFiles from git diff --name-only against origin/main, then run handoff check

mistake: Runner capturava JSON da CLI em pipe (truncamento observado), não integrava preflight e atribuía delta de saldo como cobrança por job; planos confundiam duração/cotação.
cost: nenhum gasto nesta auditoria; impacto histórico não quantificado
root_cause: contratos locais divergentes e captura sem garantia de JSON completo; não idioma da skill
solution: captura temporária, preflight antes do envio, contrato de inputs/elements unificado, cobrança declarada separada e planos bloqueados
rule_added: validar modelo/entradas antes de upload; registrar incerteza sem retry; delta não comprova cobrança e referência motion exige duração
risk: regras textuais, autorização e permissões globais ainda exigem revisão específica

mistake: A keyframe KF-galileo-listening.jpg contém bytes PNG, com extensão incompatível.
detected_by: preflight e inspeção local de assinatura
cost: nenhuma geração adicional para corrigir formato
root_cause: Nome legado não representa o formato real do arquivo.
solution: Cópia byte a byte para AB-MIN-shared-keyframe.png antes do único upload; original mantido.
rule_added: Validar formato pelo conteúdo e preparar cópia com extensão correta sem sobrescrever originais.

mistake: Current asset catalog mixed six/eight fields, used origin paths as path_base, and retained superseded hash corrections under duplicate IDs.
detected_by: Strict CSV/path validator and streamed file-hash checks
root_cause: Legacy record shape and current/historical corrections shared one active CSV; malformed path-base fields were not normalized.
solution: Normalize only proven paths/hashes, retain origin literals, consolidate existing explicit correction records under the same IDs, and archive the complete before CSV with row-level audit.
rule_added: Use the single eight-field active registry with unique IDs; preserve historical rows in audit history and run manage.py assets validate plus frontend exporter checks before delivery.
status: technical_catalog_repaired; four historical origin literals remain unverified
